requirements.summary_uz: Texnik qismdan o'tish uchun minimal ball 50.

flags.quote: Мувофиклиги бахоланиши лозим булган давлат ветеринария хизмати назорати остидаги махсулотлар
flags.explanation_uz: Xarid predmeti uch sharoshkali burg'ulash dolotalari, lekin 5-mezon davlat veterinariya xizmati nazoratidagi mahsulotlar uchun muvofiqlik hujjatini baholaydi: hujjat biriktirilsa 5 ball, biriktirilmasa 1 ball. Dolota uchun bunday hujjat bo'lishi mumkin emas, shuning uchun ishtirokchi 4 ballni yo'qotishi mumkin. Bu matn platformaning standart shablonidan olingan ko'rinadi.
flags.explanation_en: The lot buys three-cone drill bits, yet criterion 5 scores a conformity document for products under state veterinary control: 5 points if attached, 1 if not. No such document can exist for drill bits, so a bidder may lose 4 points. The wording appears to come from the platform's standard template.
flags.rewrite_uz: 5-mezon chiqarib tashlansin yoki quyidagicha bayon etilsin: «Tovarning texnik jihatdan tartibga solish sohasidagi normativ hujjatlarga muvofiqligi: tovar majburiy sertifikatlanishi lozim bo'lsa, muvofiqlik sertifikati taqdim etiladi; talab xarid predmetiga taalluqli bo'lmasa, barcha ishtirokchilarga to'liq ball beriladi».
flags.rewrite_en: Remove criterion 5, or word it as: "Conformity of the goods with technical-regulation documents: where the goods are subject to mandatory certification, a conformity certificate is provided; where the requirement does not apply to the subject of the purchase, all bidders receive full points."

reasons_uz: Qatnashish mumkin, lekin avval quyidagi shartlar bo'yicha buyurtmachidan tushuntirish so'rang.

Xarid predmetiga aloqasi bo'lmagan talab (1-bet): Xarid predmeti uch sharoshkali burg'ulash dolotalari, lekin 5-mezon davlat veterinariya xizmati nazoratidagi mahsulotlar uchun muvofiqlik hujjatini baholaydi: hujjat biriktirilsa 5 ball, biriktirilmasa 1 ball. Dolota uchun bunday hujjat bo'lishi mumkin emas, shuning uchun ishtirokchi 4 ballni yo'qotishi mumkin. Bu matn platformaning standart shablonidan olingan ko'rinadi.
Buyurtmachining so'nggi 154 ta savdosida ishtirokchilar medianasi 2 ta; savdolarning 84% qismida ikki yoki undan kam ishtirokchi; eng ko'p g'olib bo'lgan yetkazib beruvchi ulushi 12%.
Diqqat: hujjatning 4 ta sahifasi mashina o'qiy olmaydigan skan, ular tahlil qilinmadi.
reasons_en: Worth bidding, but first ask the customer to clarify the conditions below.

Requirement unrelated to the subject of the purchase (page 1): The lot buys three-cone drill bits, yet criterion 5 scores a conformity document for products under state veterinary control: 5 points if attached, 1 if not. No such document can exist for drill bits, so a bidder may lose 4 points. The wording appears to come from the platform's standard template.
In the customer's last 154 deals the median number of bidders was 2; 84% of deals had two or fewer bidders; the most frequent winner took 12%.
Note: 4 page(s) of the document are scans without readable text and were not analysed.
